description_en: Queries call task details by page
description_zh: 分页查询呼叫任务明细
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs query-ai-call-detail-page --task-id 118700000000000000 --status 0 --batch-id 118300000000000000 --called-number 0537144540000 --encryption-type 1 --call-result ANSWERED --major-intent A --min-conversation-duration 0 --max-conversation-duration 20 --start-imported-time 1748948749000 --end-imported-time 1748948749000 --start-calling-time 1748948749000 --end-calling-time 1748948749000 --out-id 94ba739b-c01a-ef91-335d-4be006c34899 --detail-ids 9929132310000 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAiCallDetailPage

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

0: pending.

1: completed.

2: failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：

0：待完成。

1：已完成。

2：失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The batch ID. On the Call Task Management page, click Details to view the batch ID
parameters.help_zh: 批次号ID。在呼叫任务管理界面单击详情查看批次号ID
parameters.name: batch_id

parameters.help_en: The encryption type. Valid values: 0: no encryption. 1: MD5. 2: SHA256. 3: SM3
parameters.help_zh: 加密方式。0: 不加密；1: MD5；2: SHA256；3: SM3；
parameters.name: encryption_type

parameters.help_en:
The call result. Valid values:
CALL_FORWARDING: call forwarding.
INCOMING_CALL_BARRED: incoming call barred.
CALL_REJECTED: call rejected.
ANSWERED: answered.
USER_BUSY: user busy.
POWERED_OFF: powered off.
NO_USER_RESPONSE: out of service area.
OPERATOR_BLOCK: blocked by carrier.
OTHERS: other status.
SUSPEND: suspended.
CANCEL: canceled by caller.
INVALID_NUMBER: invalid number.
UNAVAILABLE: temporarily unavailable.
NETWORK_BUSY: network busy.
NO_ANSWER: no answer
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫结果。取值：
CALL_FORWARDING：呼叫转移。
INCOMING_CALL_BARRED：限制呼入。
CALL_REJECTED：拒接。
ANSWERED：用户接通。
USER_BUSY：被叫忙。
POWERED_OFF：关机。
NO_USER_RESPONSE：不在服务区。
OPERATOR_BLOCK：运营商拦截。
OTHERS：其他状态。
SUSPEND：停机。
CANCEL：主叫取消。
INVALID_NUMBER：空号。
UNAVAILABLE：暂时无法接通。
NETWORK_BUSY：网络忙。
NO_ANSWER：无应答
parameters.name: call_result

parameters.help_en: The major intent. On the Communication Agent Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/agent/customize) page, click agent details to view the major intent
parameters.help_zh: 主意图。在通信智能体管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/agent/customize)界面单击智能体详情查看主意图
parameters.name: major_intent

parameters.help_en: The minimum conversation duration. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 通话时长下限。单位：分钟
parameters.name: min_conversation_duration

parameters.help_en: The maximum conversation duration. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 通话时长上限。单位：分钟
parameters.name: max_conversation_duration

parameters.help_en: The start import time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 起始导入时间，时间戳，单位：ms
parameters.name: start_imported_time

parameters.help_en: The end import time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束导入时间，时间戳，单位：ms
parameters.name: end_imported_time

parameters.help_en: The start calling time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 起始呼叫时间，时间戳，单位：ms
parameters.name: start_calling_time

parameters.help_en: The end calling time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束呼叫时间，时间戳，单位：ms
parameters.name: end_calling_time

parameters.help_en: The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the receipt message
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的ID。最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The list of task detail IDs. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 任务明细ID列表，最多不能超过100个
parameters.name: detail_ids

parameters.help_en: The current page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于0，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size
